reference_strain: Escherichia coli K-12 MG1655 (reference for cell geometry)

structures.name: 70S ribosome
structures.description: A molecular machine that translates messenger RNA into proteins. Its activity in the visualization responds to the coarse-grained translation variable.
structures.confidence: experimental atomic structure; illustrative cellular placement

structures.name: RNA polymerase
structures.description: An enzyme complex that reads DNA and synthesizes RNA. The displayed structure is from another E. coli strain, identified for context rather than asserted as K-12-specific.
structures.confidence: experimental structure; illustrative localization and count

structures.name: ATP synthase
structures.pdb_strain: E. coli (strain annotation varies by chain)
structures.description: Membrane complex that uses the proton motive force to synthesize ATP. The scene brightens these markers when the simplified energy state is higher.
structures.confidence: experimental structure; illustrative localization and count

structures.name: Bacterial nucleoid
structures.description: The DNA-rich cytoplasmic region. The drawn looping strands are a schematic representation, not the measured chromosome conformation.

structures.name: Cell envelope
structures.description: A Gram-negative cell envelope: outer membrane, peptidoglycan/periplasm, and inner membrane. Thicknesses and scaling are stylized for legibility.
